cohort: 600 women (300 undergoing caesarean section and 300 having vaginal delivery) in two main hospitals of Isfahan, Iran during 2013 and 2014
finding: The study found that while vaginal delivery has benefits, cesarean section can significantly reduce maternal and neonatal mortality and morbidity, particularly in emergency situations.
mod_finding: Infant mortality was lower in the cesarean delivery group compared to the vaginal delivery group, while there was no significant difference in the incidence of fever after delivery.
